# ScreenAreaSelection

**Class:** `UltraCanvasScreenAreaSelection` · **Group:** [Pickers, dialogs and feedback](../Groups/Pickers-dialogs-and-feedback.md) · **Header:** [`UltraCanvas/include/UltraCanvasScreenAreaPicker.h`](../../../UltraCanvas/include/UltraCanvasScreenAreaPicker.h) · `#include "UltraCanvasScreenAreaPicker.h"`

**Inherits:** [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md) → `Element`

## What it is for

Let the person choose an area of the screen - a rectangle dragged or a window clicked over the frozen, dimmed screen - for a screenshot or a recording; `UltraCanvasScreenAreaSelection` is its marquee ([doc](../../UltraCanvas/UltraCanvasScreenAreaPicker.md))

## Overview

namespace ScreenArea ui-reuse-exempt: the marquee itself - a self-rendered view of the dimmed screen, the rectangle being dragged, its size and the hint; the frozen screen is the image element beneath it.

## Guides and examples

The component documentation with explained, compiled C++ examples:

## Creating it

Constructors:

```cpp
explicit UltraCanvasScreenAreaSelection(const std::string& identifier);
```

The first string argument is always the element's **identifier**, never its text (see [Core concepts](../Core-Concepts.md#identifiers)).

Assign a lambda to the member (or call the setter). Capture the element and its parents **raw**, never as a `shared_ptr` - see [Events and callbacks](../Events-and-Callbacks.md#ownership).

|---|---|---|
| `onSelected` | `std::function<void(const Rect2Df&)> onSelected` | A selection: the rectangle in the element's (logical) coordinates |

## Option types in this header

### enum `ScreenAreaMode`

What a press of Enter takes, and what a click takes: a dragged rectangle (Enter: the whole screen), a window (a click on it; Enter: the one under the pointer), or the whole screen (the caller takes it without the picker)

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Rectangle` |  |
| `Window` |  |
| `FullScreen` |  |
